study.question: Does retaining historical auxiliary-feedback membership during compression, together with direct historical-action input to target-conditioned scoring, recover auxiliary information without sacrificing the click quality and cost advantages of simple compression?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: uniform10 has click AUC 0.65757059 versus DIN 0.65554408 and p50 batch latency 9.107 versus 15.254 ms, but buy AUC falls from 0.87018228 to 0.85669814, with cart and fav also lower. All four initial compression runs succeed; none is repeated. Target category/brand stratification match20 has weaker click AUC than uniform20 and rotated20, so its intended click mechanism is unsupported, although buy AUC 0.86601363 exceeds uniform20 0.85985053 and rotated20 0.85923181. A provisional explanation is loss of item/feedback association under mixed-feedback arithmetic means, combined with a scorer that sees item keys but no historical action. In ten contiguous ten-event blocks, partition events disjointly into any historical cart/fav/buy versus all other valid events; retain joint item/action means and event counts. Expose the compressed historical action embedding to the same target-conditioned activation MLP. The two changes may interact because action-homogeneous summaries make action-conditioned selection more informative. This is an unverified mechanism hypothesis, not a claim that the observed task tradeoff establishes its cause.

nearest_work.difference: Exact-version archived primary text inspected, notably section 4.3 lines 250-277: target-dependent local activation and unnormalized intensity are inherited. The supplied four-task adaptation, not an exact DIN reproduction, adds historical-action values. Proposed changes are pre-scorer feedback partitioning and historical-action inputs to the scorer; no original-priority claim.

Pinned benchmark forward lines 123-170 initializes per-task sequence hubs using historical task masks. Here the masks define a single disjoint auxiliary-union versus other partition before target scoring, with no learned hub projections, task tokens, iterative aggregation or broadcast. This is a benchmark-code comparison only; original paper:infnet full text is unavailable in the authorized archive, so equivalence and novelty remain unverified.

Pinned benchmark forward lines 127-158 and benchmark section 2.3 describe local-group compression and repeated unified interaction. Existing arithmetic compression is inherited from the prior local study; the new partition preserves auxiliary-feedback association, not learned inner Transformers or recent-query layers. Original paper:longer is link-only, so detailed original-method comparison is unresolved.

Pinned loader lines 383-406 constructs task masks from action-token membership; lines 525-577 applies history validity and leaves target action zero; lines 579-594 confirms pre-padding. This verifies the interface semantics, not predictive effectiveness. No new data, label access or action-ID mapping is introduced.

Host-owned data identities, causal visibility, four labels, full-population validation, training seed20262027, one epoch, batch8192, split optimizers, BF16 and equal unweighted BCE are unchanged.
study.proposed_difference: A prospective 2x2 factorial changes routing (historical cart|fav|buy membership versus deterministic occupancy-matched membership rotation) and scorer access (compressed historical-action embedding versus an equally shaped zero input). Each event belongs to exactly one of two strata in its original ten-event block, including overlapping auxiliary actions only once; all100 positions remain represented and no events are selected from outside the input. All cells score20 slots, share identical tensor shapes, nominal parameters and initialization order, and differ only in these flags. Scorer input adds16 columns, i.e.1024 weights with default first hidden width64, to every new cell; expected total32,060,453 and dense267,237, subject to host measurement. This is a modest adaptation, not a verified novel unified architecture. The old uniform20 trial is an external simple-compression comparator, not a fresh member of the factorial; the old uniform10 incumbent remains the validation selection reference. Local preparation checks: complete study-schema traversal passed (jsonschema is not installed); all four modules compile as Python source without imports; exhaustive exact-arithmetic reference checks passed for all2047 feedback-membership patterns over valid suffix lengths0..10, including empty histories, padding exclusion, disjoint assignment, exact occupancy matching and count-weighted constant-gate sum preservation. Rotation changed1974 of2047 patterns in this unweighted combinatorial diagnostic; this is not a dataset disruption rate. All five ancestor source hashes and baseline_reference.py remain unchanged. Torch is absent, so these checks do not establish tensor execution, gradients, BF16 behavior or performance. No training, installation or withheld assessment was launched.
predictions: Predeclared validation selection remains full-population is_click AUC alone. The main candidate feedback_action is useful only if it improves this score over the incumbent; auxiliary improvements alone do not make it the selected model. For a useful task-preservation tradeoff, additionally inspect click loss <=0.0005 versus uniform10 and all auxiliary AUC/Logloss values, without calling that threshold statistical noninferiority.

Routing support requires feedback_action minus rotated_action to improve auxiliary mean AUC; a practical preliminary target is >=0.002 with buy AUC improving >=0.004. Check the corresponding feedback_item minus rotated_item effect and the action-enabled versus item-only effects. These are prospective effect-size screens on one frozen seed, not significance thresholds.

Estimate the interaction for each metric as (feedback_action - rotated_action) - (feedback_item - rotated_item). A positive auxiliary interaction is predicted if action-aware scoring specifically benefits preserved feedback groups. A positive main effect without interaction supports only its simpler component interpretation.

Each new cell has20 scorer slots and exactly matching slot occupancies within its routing pair. Expect model-only p50 latency below the full100-event DIN reference and peak memory below its4.197GB. No equal-compute superiority is asserted from matched data passes: compare measured wall/GPU seconds, examples, parameters, memory, p50/p95 latency and throughput as a quality-cost tradeoff.

Host preflight must establish finite four-task [B,1] probabilities and backward gradients under the frozen BF16 execution; all-empty histories must produce zero pooled history; masked item/action changes must not affect evaluation predictions; missing masks must fail explicitly. Existing length slices empty/1-16/17-64/>64 remain fixed and exploratory for mechanism diagnosis, with counts and positive/negative support. New feedback-composition slices require an authorized diagnostic interface and adequate training-defined support; they are not assumed available here.
falsifiers: If feedback versus rotated routing has zero or negative auxiliary mean effects in both scorer conditions, this implementation does not support the feedback-association hypothesis. Existing match20 evidence already does not support its intended click mechanism; it is retained rather than reinterpreted as success.

If action input has no benefit within true feedback groups, the proposed action-conditioned scoring mechanism is unsupported. If it benefits both routes equally and interaction is absent, attribute it to the scorer input rather than joint design.

If auxiliary gains require click degradation beyond0.0005 or costs approach/exceed DIN without a compensating quality improvement, this implementation fails the intended preservation/efficiency tradeoff. A candidate that fails to improve incumbent click AUC is not selected merely for auxiliary gains.

A failure of mask/current-label isolation, target-action exclusion, exact per-block count preservation, finite execution or resource limits invalidates the affected trial; it is an execution/integrity failure, not scientific counterevidence. No local forward/backward result is claimed because the coding environment has no torch.

One frozen-seed improvement or failure is preliminary. Lack of task-conditional routing, unioning three rare feedback types, and within-stratum item heterogeneity leave other implementations of feedback-preserving compression open.
alternative_explanations: Compression may regularize the fixed one-pass optimization rather than preserve a useful mechanism; all current observations are one seed and validation has already guided search.

Dice uses BatchNorm over all scored slots, including empty summaries. Routing changes key distributions and training normalization statistics even though occupancy counts and slot count are matched; future masked-normalization controls would be needed to isolate that contribution.

The rotated negative control preserves counts but retains some true membership in homogeneous, singleton or periodic blocks, so it is a partial disruption, not an independent random permutation or perfect null.

All four cells have matched nominal capacity; zero-action cells have inactive scorer columns and therefore lower effective input capacity. A scorer gain could reflect access to a useful feature or extra active capacity, not a special action-specific interaction. No within-round gain establishes a novel architecture.

The gate widening changes Xavier fan-in and downstream RNG draws versus historical trials, so comparisons to uniform10/uniform20 do not isolate only routing; causal claims use the four new matched cells. Separate repeated controls remain necessary.

The union partition mixes cart/fav/buy and is not direct advertisement conversion attribution; labels reflect user/category/brand matches within24h under official_offline visibility. Benchmark delayed feedback maturity and whole-window vocab/static snapshots limit production transfer.
Lower model latency may not improve end-to-end wall time because loading/embedding cost dominates; the previous10 versus20-slot wall times are already essentially tied.
